accounts_owner_ck.name: accounts_owner_ck
accounts_owner_ck.value:
("accounts"."kind" = 'System' AND "accounts"."code" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."student_id" IS NULL AND "accounts"."employee_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("accounts"."kind" = 'Customer' AND num_nonnulls("accounts"."student_id", "accounts"."employee_id") = 1)
